text_rules: Keep cover text to 3-5 punchy words mixing Hindi/English with at least one number (₹ amount, GSM, piece count, or a shocking stat); frame it as a question or loss/damage statement to trigger curiosity — never use abstract or educational jargon-only text like 'BIOWASH ≠ PRESHRUNK' that requires prior knowledge to care about.
layout: Place all text in the vertical 25%-70% band (safe from Instagram grid-crop at top and YouTube UI at bottom), using bold sans-serif type with thick black stroke; product or warehouse imagery fills the background with slight dark overlay so yellow/white text pops even at tiny mobile preview size.
patterns: Top-performing Indian business Reels thumbnails combine a specific ₹ loss amount or piece count with a concrete consequence (cracked, rejected, wasted) — the formula is NUMBER + PROBLEM + SCALE. Winning covers skip faces entirely and hero the product defect or shocking visual proof instead. Yellow keyword on dark/busy background with white supporting text is the dominant high-CTR color pattern across wholesale/garment niches.
ig_patterns: Highest save-rate covers promise actionable checklists framed as loss-prevention ('3 Checks That Save Your Business') with a specific ₹ amount at stake — viewers bookmark these as reference tools. Highest share-rate covers expose a hidden industry problem ('200 GSM But Feels Cheap?') that buyers want to warn peers about — the 'my friend needs to see this' trigger is a relatable scam/quality trap, not generic education. Cream/navy illustration-style covers and jargon-heavy Hindi text ('BIOWASH ≠ PRESHRUNK', 'YARN COUNT बड़ा = पतला?') consistently fail on both saves and shares because they lack emotional stakes and read as textbook content rather than urgent warnings.
